T: Put the bunny back in the box.
D: A paroled Army Ranger on a prison transport plane gets caught up in a hijack.
P: Serve dessert when Poe finally hands over the bunny.
S: Honey roasted peanuts with chili flakes and smoked salt
Honey-roasted peanuts tossed with chilli flakes and a little smoked salt, warmed at 160C for 5 minutes, in small paper bags.

Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy, brown sugar, smoked paprika and black pepper, slow-dried in the oven until chewy with a sticky, smoky bite. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp cracked black pepper and 1 tsp garlic powder. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.
Poached prawns served cold with horseradish cocktail sauce
Prawns poached and iced on shredded iceberg in martini glasses, spicy cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and hot sauce.
M: the stop at the abandoned airfield

Thick chuck patty griddled to medium with melted cheddar, crisp bacon, sticky grilled onion and smoky barbecue mayo on a toasted brioche bun. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties 2cm thick. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 15 minutes. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Season the patties and griddle 4 minutes a side on high heat, then top with 2 slices cheddar each, add a splash of water and cover 1 minute. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Toast 4 brioche buns and build with sauce, patty, bacon and onions.
Seared sirloin with garlic butter, plus a baked potato
Sirloin seared hard, rested and topped with garlic butter, baked potato split and loaded with sour cream and chives.
W: Sponge cake with buttercream and coconut, cut and shaped like a rabbit
Vanilla cake cut and assembled into a bunny, covered in white buttercream and shredded coconut, pink ears, presented in a box.
K: Bourbon shaken with muddled lemon, mint and sugar syrup over ice

Bourbon muddled with lemon wedges, mint and sugar syrup, shaken and poured over crushed ice with a big mint sprig on top. In a shaker, muddle 1 lemon cut into 8 wedges with 12 mint leaves and 60ml sugar syrup. Add 200ml bourbon and a scoop of ice and shake for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Top each with a big sprig of mint, slapped between your hands first to wake it up.

s.note: Warm chilli honey peanuts in little paper bags
s.how: Toss 300g honey-roasted peanuts with half a tsp chilli flakes and a pinch of smoked salt. Warm on a tray at 160C for 5 minutes, then cool for a few minutes. Divide between four small paper bags.

s.note: Prawn cocktail in martini glasses with spicy cocktail sauce
s.how: Poach 500g green prawns for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel. Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish, lemon juice and a dash of hot sauce. Serve on shredded iceberg in martini glasses with lemon wedges.

m.note: Garlic butter sirloin with a loaded baked potato
m.how: Bake 4 large potatoes at 200C for an hour. Sear 4 sirloins hard and rest 5 minutes. Mash 60g butter with 2 garlic cloves and put a slice on each steak. Split the potatoes and load with sour cream and chives.

w.note: Vanilla cake shaped like a bunny, covered in coconut
w.how: Cut a round sponge cake into a body and two ears. Beat 200g butter with 350g icing sugar and cover the cake. Press 100g shredded coconut all over. Tint a little coconut pink for the ears and put it in a box with a bow.

d.note: Bourbon muddled with lemon wedges, mint and sugar syrup, shaken and poured over crushed ice with a big mint sprig on top.
d.how: In a shaker, muddle 1 lemon cut into 8 wedges with 12 mint leaves and 60ml sugar syrup. Add 200ml bourbon and a scoop of ice and shake for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Top each with a big sprig of mint, slapped between your hands first to wake it up.
